senses.example: The two sides agreed that war was imminent.
senses.exampleCN: 双方都同意战争迫在眉睫。
senses.why: The Latin verb minere means to overhang, so what is imminent hangs over our heads and is about to fall.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语动词 minere 意为「悬在上方」，所以 imminent 描述的事就悬在我们头顶、随时落下。

senses.title: Danger that may strike without delay
senses.definition: threatening danger that calls for immediate action
senses.definitionCN: 威胁临近，需要立即采取行动的危险
senses.example: The sign warns of imminent rock fall on the cliff.
senses.exampleCN: 标牌警告崖壁有落石危险。
senses.why: The overhanging image suits threats better than anything else, so danger words dominate its use.
senses.whyCN: 「悬在头顶」的画面最适合形容威胁，所以这个词常与危险类词语搭配。

senses.title: An event or arrival that is close in time
senses.titleCN: 临近的；即将到来的（中性）
senses.definition: an event that is approaching, used without a negative tone
senses.definitionCN: 正在靠近的事件，不带负面语气
senses.example: The imminent arrival of spring changed the mood of the town.
senses.exampleCN: 春天即将到来，小镇的气氛也变了。
senses.why: Once the word means simply close at hand, it can describe neutral events as well as threats.
senses.whyCN: 当这个词只表示「马上就要到」，它也能形容中性的事件，「悬在头顶」的紧张感就淡了。

senses.title: Legal and formal use for an urgent risk
senses.titleCN: （法律、公文）紧迫的；事态紧急的
senses.definition: used in official texts for a risk that requires action before it becomes serious
senses.definitionCN: 公文术语中用于指事态在恶化前须立即处理的紧急风险
senses.example: Officials declared an imminent risk to public health.
senses.exampleCN: 官员宣布公共卫生面临事态紧急的风险。
senses.why: Law and diplomacy need a precise word for a present threat, and they found it in the classical sense.
senses.whyCN: 法律与外交需要精确表达「眼前的威胁」，于是沿用了这个词的古典含义。

senses.title: Signs that something is about to happen
senses.definition: said of signs or warnings that show an event is close
senses.definitionCN: 指迹象或预警显示某事即将发生
senses.example: Heavy traffic was an imminent sign of the holiday rush.
senses.exampleCN: 车流拥堵是个明确的信号，说明假日出行高峰即将到来。
senses.why: The sight of something hanging overhead is itself the sign of an approaching fall.
senses.whyCN: 头顶悬挂之物的样子，本身就是一个「将要落下」的征兆。

intro.en: Imminent comes from Latin imminere, to overhang or threaten, built on minere, to project.
intro.cn: imminent 来自拉丁语 imminere（悬在上方、威胁），词根为 minere（突出、伸出）。

items.en: The base is generally traced to a root meaning to project or stand out.
items.cn: 词基一般认为来自表示「突出、伸出」的远古词根。

items.en: Minere means to project, and minae means threats.
items.cn: minere 意为突出，minae 意为威胁。

items.en: Imminere means to overhang, and immineo means I hang over.
items.cn: imminere 意为悬在上方，immineo 意为「我悬在……之上」。

items.en: The adjective imminent enters French with the sense of threatening.
items.cn: 形容词 imminent 以「威胁性的」之意进入法语。

items.en: English adopts imminent for something about to happen.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪引进 imminent，指即将发生的事。

items.en: Modern English also uses it for neutral arrivals, as in an imminent award.
items.cn: 现代英语也用它形容中性事件，如奖项即将颁发。

note.en: Imminent is a classical adjective of overhanging, easily confused with the near homophones immanent and eminent.
note.cn: imminent 是表示「悬在上方」的古典形容词，容易与同音的 immanent、eminent 混淆。

entries.definition: present everywhere inside the world
entries.definitionCN: 内在的；无所不在的；只是读音相近，词源不同

entries.definition: famous and respected in a field
entries.definitionCN: 著名的；杰出的；只是读音相近，词源不同

entries.definition: the state of being about to happen
about to happen soon, usually unpleasant
going to happen or appear soon
entries.definitionCN: 即将到来的；即将推出的

entries.definition: happening soon

normalIntro.en: Imminent keeps the Latin image of something hanging over your head, about to drop.
normalIntro.cn: imminent 保留了拉丁语「有东西悬在头顶、即将落下」的画面。

normal.en: The in- prefix puts the event over you, so it hangs like a storm cloud.
normal.cn: 前缀 in- 表示「在上面」，事情就像雷雨云一样压在你头顶。

normal.en: Imminent danger is the most common pair, so learn the two together.
normal.cn: imminent danger 是最常见的搭配，最好两个词一起记。

normal.en: The adverb is imminently, as in a storm that is imminently due.
normal.cn: 副词是 imminently，例如暴风雨马上要来。

normal.en: Keep the double m: imminent ends in -nent, like permanent.
normal.cn: 记住双写的 m：imminent 结尾是 -nent，和 permanent 一样。

normal.en: Compare impending: both mean coming soon, but imminent stresses how close it now is.
normal.cn: 对比 impending：两者都指快来了，但 imminent 更强调「就在眼前」。

abstract.en: See a heavy cloud hanging just above the roof.
abstract.cn: 想象一片沉甸甸的云就挂在屋顶上。

abstract.en: Think of a red warning light blinking faster each second.
abstract.cn: 想象一盏红色警示灯一秒比一秒闪得快。

abstract.en: Picture a runner leaning forward at the starting line.
abstract.cn: 想象一名短跑运动员在起跑线上身体前倾。

examples.en: The village was told that the flood was imminent.
examples.cn: 村里接到通知，洪水即将到来。

examples.en: She felt the danger was so imminent that she called the police.
examples.cn: 她感到危险迫在眉睫，于是报了警。

examples.en: Nobody expected the collapse of the bridge to be imminent.
examples.cn: 没人料到桥梁的坍塌近在眼前。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一觅们」——大家四处寻觅着出口，因为危险已经悬在头顶，马上就要来；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 in-（在上）＋ minere（突出、悬伸）→ imminere（悬在上方、威胁）→ 古法语 imminent → 英语 imminent，核心义「悬在头顶、即将落下」。

sensesIntro.en: Imminent starts as a hovering threat, keeps that force in danger phrases, then spreads to any event close in time and to official wording.
sensesIntro.cn: imminent 起于「悬在头顶的威胁」，在危险语境里保持这种压迫感，随后扩展到任何即将发生的事件，也成为公文用词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a storm cloud hanging just above the roof.
core.cn: 核心意象：一片乌云就悬在屋顶上方。

branches.en: Soon to happen is the plain time sense.
branches.cn: 「很快就要发生」是最朴素的时间义项。

branches.en: Overhanging danger is the core threat sense.
branches.cn: 悬顶的危险是核心的威胁义项。

branches.en: Neutral arrivals show the word without fear.
branches.cn: 中性事件的用法去掉了恐惧色彩。

branches.en: Official documents use the word for urgent risk.
branches.cn: 公文用它表示事态紧急的风险。

branches.en: A sign that something will happen soon belongs with the time sense.
branches.cn: 预示即将发生的迹象，与时间义项相呼应。

intro.en: Imminent is built from the Latin prefix in-, the stem min-, and the adjective ending -ent, with imminently and imminence beside it.
intro.cn: imminent 由前缀 in-、词干 min- 与形容词词尾 -ent 构成，同族还有 imminently 与 imminence。

latinIntro.en: Latin minere means to project, and imminere means to hang over.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 minere 意为突出，imminere 意为悬在上方。

items.example: The prefix in- places the event over our heads.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 in- 把事情放到头顶上方。

items.example: Minere gives the projecting image.
items.exampleCN: minere 提供「突出」的意象。

items.example: Imminere is the direct source of the adjective.
items.exampleCN: imminere 是这个形容词的直接来源。

items.example: The ending -ent forms imminent.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ent 构成 imminent。

items.example: The suffix -ly forms imminently.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ly 构成 imminently。

items.example: The suffix -ence forms imminence.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ence 构成 imminence。

items.example: Prominent uses pro-, meaning forward.
items.exampleCN: prominent 用 pro-，表示「向前」。

items.example: Eminent uses e-, meaning out.
items.exampleCN: eminent 用 e-，表示「向外」。

items.example: Impending comes from pendere, to hang.
items.exampleCN: impending 来自 pendere（悬挂）。

definition_zh: 不能移动的；固定的；一动不动的
definition_en: unable to move, or not moving at all
core_image: 一个人僵在原地，双脚像被钉在地面上
scene: 救护车赶到时，伤者平躺在地，背和脖子都不能动。After the accident he lay immobile on the road until the ambulance arrived.
sceneCN: 这里 immobile 是「一动不动的」（第 2 个义项：身体无法活动或保持静止），句意：事故后他一动不动地躺在路上，直到救护车赶到。

pos.zh: 不能移动的；不能活动的；静止不动的

derivatives.zh: 加名词词尾 -ity，义为「不能移动；静止不动」
加动词词尾 -ize，义为「使固定不动；使无法活动」
immobilize 的过去分词，义为「被固定住的」

senses.title: Unable to move from injury or illness
senses.titleCN: （身体）不能活动的；动弹不得的
senses.definition: not able to move the body because of injury, illness, or age
senses.definitionCN: 因受伤、生病或年老而无法活动身体
senses.example: His knee was immobile for six weeks after surgery.
senses.exampleCN: 手术后他的膝盖有六周不能活动。
senses.why: The Latin prefix in- means not, and mobilis means able to move, so immobile is simply not able to move.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语前缀 in- 表示「不」，mobilis 表示「能动的」，所以 immobile 字面上就是「不能动」。

senses.title: Not moving at all
senses.definition: standing or lying still and making no movement
senses.definitionCN: 站或躺着完全静止，没有任何动作
senses.example: The cat stood immobile beside the open door.
senses.exampleCN: 猫一动不动地站在敞开的门边。
senses.why: The same word covers a short state of stillness, not just a lasting inability.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词也涵盖短暂的静止状态，并不限于长久的不能活动。

senses.title: Fixed and impossible to move
senses.definition: said of an object that is heavy or fixed in place and hard to shift
senses.definitionCN: 形容物体沉重或固定在原处、难以挪动
senses.example: The old safe was too immobile to move upstairs.
senses.exampleCN: 那只旧保险箱重得没法搬上楼。
senses.why: The prefix applies as easily to things as to bodies, so a fixed object is also immobile.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 in- 既能加在人身上，也能加在物体上，所以固定不动的物体同样称为 immobile。

senses.title: Stuck in social or economic terms
senses.definition: unable to change social class, job, or position
senses.definitionCN: 无法改变阶层、职业或处境
senses.example: Low wages left many workers immobile in the same job.
senses.exampleCN: 低工资让许多工人困在同一份工作里难以流动。
senses.why: Social movement is imagined as physical movement, so people who cannot rise are called immobile.
senses.whyCN: 社会流动被想象成身体的移动，所以无法向上流动的人被形容为 immobile。

senses.title: Kept still by a device or restraint
senses.definition: held still by a splint, cast, or brake
senses.definitionCN: 由夹板、石膏或制动装置保持不动
senses.example: The leg stays immobile inside the cast for a month.
senses.exampleCN: 腿在石膏里要固定一个月不动。
senses.why: Medicine and machines take the plain sense and apply it to concrete means of holding still.
senses.whyCN: 医学和机械把朴素的「不能动」义应用到具体的固定手段上。

intro.en: Immobile is Latin for immovable, made of in-, meaning not, and mobilis, from movere, to move.
intro.cn: immobile 在拉丁语中就是「不能移动的」，由 in-（不）与 mobilis（可动的，来自 movere「移动」）构成。

items.en: The base movere goes back to a root meaning to push away.
items.cn: movere 可上溯到表示「推、推开」的古老词根。

items.en: Movere means to move, and mobilis means able to be moved.
items.cn: movere 意为移动，mobilis 意为可移动的。

items.en: Immobilis means not movable, and immobilis is used of fixed objects.
items.cn: immobilis 意为不可移动的，常用于固定的物体。

items.en: French borrowed the word as immobile in the sense of unable to move.
items.cn: 法语借入该词为 immobile，指不能移动的。

items.en: English uses immobile for both fixed objects and still bodies.
items.cn: 英语在十七世纪用 immobile 形容固定物体与静止的身体。

items.en: Modern English adds social uses, as in socially immobile groups.
items.cn: 现代英语又增加了社会语域的用法，如难以流动的群体。

note.en: Immobile is a negated adjective from movere, close to mobile, mobility, and immobility, and to words for being still.
note.cn: immobile 是由 movere 加否定前缀构成的形容词，与 mobile、mobility、immobility 同根，与「静止不动」一类词意义相近。

entries.definition: able to move or be moved easily
the state of being unable to move
to make something unable to move
entries.definitionCN: 使固定不动；使无法活动

entries.definition: not moving at all
not moving or standing still
unable to move part of the body
entries.definitionCN: 瘫痪的；身体无法活动的

normalIntro.en: Immobile joins in-, the negative prefix, to mobile, from Latin movere, so it says plainly not able to move.
normalIntro.cn: immobile 把否定前缀 in- 与 mobile（来自拉丁语 movere，移动）接在一起，朴素地表示「不能动」。

normal.en: Mobile is the positive partner, as in a mobile phone.
normal.cn: 与之相对的是 mobile，例如 mobile phone 里的 mobile。

normal.en: The noun is immobility, the state of not moving.
normal.cn: 名词是 immobility，指不能移动的状态。

normal.en: Immobilize is the verb used for splints and casts.
normal.cn: 动词 immobilize 常用于夹板和石膏的语境。

normal.en: Compare mobility: the word keeps the same mov- stem behind both forms.
normal.cn: 对比 mobility：两者背后是同一个 mov- 词干。

normal.en: Lie still is the everyday way of saying stay immobile.
normal.cn: 日常说 stay immobile 就是「躺着别动」。

abstract.en: Picture a statue that wears a coat but never walks.
abstract.cn: 想象一尊穿着外套却从不行走的雕像。

abstract.en: See a child who freezes mid-step during a game.
abstract.cn: 想象一个孩子在游戏中迈到一半就僵住不动了。

abstract.en: Imagine a heavy machine rooted to the factory floor.
abstract.cn: 想象一台重型机器在车间地面上生了根。

examples.en: He stayed immobile until the rescue team reached the shaft.
examples.cn: 他一动不动，直到救援队到达竖井。

examples.en: Scans show the arm will be immobile for several months.
examples.cn: 扫描显示这条手臂将有几个月不能活动。

examples.en: Poor road links keep the region economically immobile.
examples.cn: 交通不畅让这个地区经济上难以流动。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「硬莫摆」——硬邦邦的，想怎么摆都摆不动，就是不能移动；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 in-（不）＋ mobilis（可移动的，来自 movere「移动」）→ 拉丁语 immobilis（不可移动的）→ 法语 immobile → 英语 immobile，核心义「不能动」。

sensesIntro.en: Immobile applies the negative in- to movere, so it covers bodies that cannot move, things that are still or fixed, and people who cannot move up in society.
sensesIntro.cn: immobile 把否定前缀 in- 加到 movere（移动）前，因此既能指无法活动的身体，也能指静止或固定的物体，还能指难以向上流动的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a body frozen in place with feet nailed to the road.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人僵在原地，双脚像被钉在地面上。

branches.en: The inability of a body is the first sense.
branches.cn: 身体无法活动是第一个义项。

branches.en: Standing still is the brief version of the same idea.
branches.cn: 静止不动是同一概念短暂化的版本。

branches.en: Fixed objects show the literal sense applied to things.
branches.cn: 固定的物体体现字面义在物体上的应用。

branches.en: Social movement borrows the image of the body.
branches.cn: 社会流动借用了身体移动的画面。

branches.en: Splints and casts keep the limb in the first sense.
branches.cn: 夹板与石膏让肢体保持第一个义项的状态。

intro.en: Immobile is the negative of mobile, built on the Latin stem mov-, with immobility and immobilize around it.
intro.cn: immobile 是 mobile 的否定形式，词干来自拉丁语 mov-，周围有 immobility 与 immobilize。

latinIntro.en: Latin movere means to move, and mobilis means able to be moved.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 movere 意为移动，mobilis 意为可移动的。

items.example: The prefix in- makes mobile into immobile.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 in- 把 mobile 变成 immobile。

items.example: Movere gives the moving image.
items.exampleCN: movere 提供「移动」的意象。

items.example: Mobilis is the positive base of the pair.
items.exampleCN: mobilis 是这一对词的肯定基础。

items.example: The ending -ile forms mobile.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ile 构成 mobile。

items.example: The suffix -ity forms immobility.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ity 构成 immobility。

items.example: The suffix -ize forms immobilize.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ize 构成 immobilize。

items.example: Mobile is the everyday positive form.
items.exampleCN: mobile 是日常的肯定形式。

items.example: Moment shares the mov- stem, meaning a movement of time.
items.exampleCN: moment 共享 mov- 词干，指时间的一次移动。

items.example: Promote moves someone forward.
items.exampleCN: promote 表示把人往前推。
